verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since any security SaaS vendor can publish incident postmortems and run a live trust page, but the pack has no first-party evidence of either. The community threads mention Okta breaches (the support-portal HAR files, GitHub-hosted code), but they show neither published postmortems, a trust page, nor any assessment of disclosure honesty. No item documents the capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can judge the vendor's own record — published security incident postmortems, a live trust page, and honest disclosure history
